name: Benchmark tooling
tagline: Run BenchmarkDotNet suites and export static hub manifests.
description: Host runners for Lyo microbenchmarks. After each suite finishes, manifests refresh on-the-fly under docs/benchmarks/data. Publish to S3 with publish_s3.py for the Lyo-Public marketing site.

commands.blurb: Run BDN suites in Release; rebuild category manifests after each suite
Run one category without copying history into a local Gateway public tree
Rebuild all static hub data from artifacts/history
Refresh a single category (used by run_dotnet after each suite)
Rebuild manifests then aws s3 sync data/ + history/ (LYO_BENCH_S3_BUCKET or --bucket)
Upload existing docs/benchmarks/{data,history} JSON to the Gateway S3 bucket

notes: Categories: encryption compression hashing cache query csv xlsx lock filestorage
Prefer Python entry points under scripts/; do not add shell wrappers
